positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed a custom document generation tool for Cameo Enterprise Architecture using ReactJS, NodeJS, and Java.
•	Designed and implemented the Digital Thread Engine, an integrated CI/CD pipeline leveraging multiple services via webhooks and REST API
•	Implemented Kafka producers and consumers for real time data tracking
•	Develop full stack applications using ReactJS, Vite, TypeScript, MUI, and TailwindCSS for frontend and Node/ExpressJS for backend
•	Containerized and deployed applications with Docker and Podman
•	Integrated RESTful services including Bitbucket and Teamwork Cloud.
•	Lead Agile Scrum meetings including daily standups, sprint planning, task assignment, and sprint reviews
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · Gitlab · TypeScript · Continuous Integration (CI) · MongoDB · Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) · Java · Docker Products · JavaScript · Amazon S3 · podman
